body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. ACK the withdrawal. Implementing the split, not option 3.

MayBeMissing = {Chart, Structural, Sensory} governs missingTerms.
HasReductionReceipt = {Chart, Structural} governs reductions and receipt coherence.

Empty sensoryTerms → Estimate.Missing(AllMissing) in missingTerms, not 0.0. No Mean. No fake SourceNodeRef. No Option coverage. codec/align.scala stays untouched.

JSON shape is unchanged. A new artifact that names Sensory in missingTerms would fail a pre-split validator that only allowed Chart and Structural. Old artifacts without Sensory in that set still load. Recording that so it is not silent; it is not a type-shape change.

Member taxonomy (hit / looked-up-and-missed / never-eligible-as-excluded) goes on the bead as design for a future Sensory receipt, not in this candidate.

Working on branch align-dsens-absence in a worktree. Shared checkout stays on main.
